subject: Private offer: BlueBay EU regional commit & revenue split exception
messages:
From: Emma Torres <emma.torres@bluebayanalytics.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@bluebayanalytics.com, Jason Hart <jason.hart@aws-partner.com>
Date: 2028-07-28 13:12:00 +01:00
Subject: Request: EU private offer with regional commit and channel split

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at BlueBay is ready to move forward with a private offer on AWS for our EU customers, but we need two things that differ from your standard listing:

1) A geo-bound committed ARR for EMEA only (minimum 200k EUR first 12 months).
2) A revenue split of 35% to our channel partners for accounts sourced via our reseller network (we typically see 30-40% splits).

We attached a high-level statement of work and an initial draft of terms (redlines on the private offer). Also, because some of our customers require EU-only data residency, we asked Jason if that can be honored via an EU-only variant in the offer.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
- Create a region-constrained private offer in AWS that locks to EU marketplace sales only?
- Make a one-off rev-share exception at 35% for the first 12 months, with standard 25% thereafter?
- Support a 60-day invoicing term for the first purchase (BlueBay prefers net60 for channel-managed deals).

Appreciate a quick read and a call if needed this afternoon.

Best,
Emma Torres
Head of Partnerships | BlueBay Analytics
emma.torres@bluebayanalytics.com
+44 20 7946 0958

Attachments: BB-PrivateOffer-Draft_v2_redline.pdf; SOF_BlueBay_Q3-2028.xlsx

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Emma Torres <emma.torres@bluebayanalytics.com>, Jason Hart <jason.hart@aws-partner.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-28 13:43:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Request: EU private offer with regional commit and channel split

Emma — thanks for the note and the materials. I read the redlines. High level: we can do an EU-scoped private offer, and we can create a channel carve-out, but the 35% rev-share for twelve months is outside of standard marketplace guardrails and needs exec sign-off. The net60 request also impacts finance/collections and product billing flow — another approval path.

To move this quickly Id like to escalate to Deal Desk + Revenue Ops and loop in Legal for the redline on data residency. Marissa and Lauren — can I get an expedited decision on: 1) approving a temporary 35% channel rev-share for 12 months, 2) accepting net60 for the initial invoice, and 3) confirming we can publish an EU-only variant tied to the AWS region?

Proposed approvals summary for exec ask:
- Deal: BlueBay Analytics (BB-2028-094)
- Commit: 200,000 EUR EMEA ARR, 12-month term
- Rev-share: 35% to channel for deals attributed to BlueBay resellers for first 12 months, revert to standard 25% after month 12
- Payment: net60 for first purchase, net30 thereafter
- Data residency: EU-only deployment required for flagged SKUs (legal to confirm language)

Im attaching their redline. If we get a yes by EOD Ill coordinate with AWS (Jason) to generate the private offer and route to DocuSign.

Thanks — Karthik
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415 555 0193

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-28 14:05:00 +01:00
Subject: Exec approval request: BlueBay EU commit + 35% channel split (urgent)

Marissa / Lauren / Steph —

Summarizing the ask from BlueBay (see attached redline). Theyre ready to sign this week if we can grant three exceptions:
- One-off 35% rev-share to channel partners for first 12 months (standard is 25%).
- Net60 for first invoice only.
- EU-restricted private offer (must only be valid for AWS EU marketplace purchases).

Why this matters: BlueBay is a strategic partner with an existing reseller network in EMEA. The initial ARR commit (200k EUR) plus cross-sell potential across data analytics customers could unlock ~750k EUR in 18 months if we align on co-sell motions. They also push volume into AWS marketplace which benefits our listing metrics.

Risk/caveats:
- Rev-share: reduces Redwood gross marketplace take for first year; requires accounting and marketplace ops adjustments.
- Net60: increases DSO and collection risk; finance wants a mitigation (shorter SLA on first renewal + prepayment carve-in if renewal not met).
- Data residency: legal must confirm the EU-only variant is implementable without additional compliance backlog.

Requested decision: Approve / Decline / Approve with modifications by 17:00 CET today so we can meet BlueBays signing window.

Attachments: BB-PrivateOffer-Draft_v2_redline.pdf; SOF_BlueBay_Q3-2028.xlsx

Karthik

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-28 15:18:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval request: BlueBay EU commit + 35% channel split (urgent)

Karthik / team —

Im supportive of moving forward with a constrained exception given the partner upside, with the following tied conditions:
1) Rev-share cap: 35% limited to partner-attributed orders up to 200k EUR; any partner-sourced revenue beyond the commit will revert immediately to standard 25%.
2) Net60: approve for the initial invoice only, but require a 60% prepayment at renewal if the customer misses the first renewal milestone. Finance to draft the exact wording.
3) Data residency: Legal to review and provide final clause within 48 hours; proceed with AWS to create the EU-only SKU placeholder but dont publish until legal signs off.

Please confirm these three modifications to BlueBay so we have a clean DocuSign flow. If you can get this agreed today Ill greenlight the rev-share exception.

Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-28 17:03:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval request: BlueBay EU commit + 35% channel split (urgent)

Approved with Marissas conditions. Two operational notes before you send to the customer:
- Include an explicit 12-month sunset clause for the 35% rev-share and a reporting cadence (monthly partner attribution reports) to validate partner-sourced orders.
- Finance to issue a PO acceptance checklist; authorize net60 only after PO + signed SOF. If PO not received within 10 business days, default net30.

Karthik — you have approval to proceed to drafting the final private offer. Loop in Legal (ccd below) to finalize the data residency language and route to DocuSign. Ill notify executive sponsor for visibility.

Lauren Bishop
Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
